note: Grass campsites with shared power posts across the grounds of Historic Prairie Village, a nonprofit pioneer-town museum 2 mi west of Madison on SD-34 near Lake Herman. Busiest during the late-August steam threshing jamboree, when sites are sold as an event package; event days may add a gate fee. Wi-Fi only near the gift shop. No ATVs or UTVs. --Claude
summary: Museum's camping pages (live 2026 status, Wayback 2026-06 open notice) + site pages + Google + imagery: grass electric sites (20/30 A, some 50 A), two shower houses, dump, $25 electric / $20 dry tax included incl. admission (2023 figures, only ones posted), opening day early May (May 2, 2027) into October, reservations encouraged (phone), self-check-in after hours/after Labor Day. Ordinary nights sold all season outside events. Google 4.6/287 (museum). Not waterfront.
flags: FEES: the only posted rates ($25 electric / $20 dry, tax included) sit in text written for the 2023 season on the live village-campsites page; no 2024-2026 figure found (the 2026 camping page lists none). Price well under the gate either way.

EVENT GROUNDS: ordinary nightly camping is sold all season (gift-shop registration / self-check-in) outside events - passes the fairground test; Jamboree and Bull Ride nights carry event packages or gate fees.
GOOGLE: 4.6 stars over 287 reviews - the listing is the museum's, not the campground's alone.
LONG-STAY: nightly only; no seasonal sites, minimums or age limits.

SITES: stored count 230 (from the sweep note) is unsourced; the clickable campsite map has ~300 numbered site links across eight sections (operator text says 'dozens of electrical campsites'). Left as stored.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - Lake Herman is ~350 m west beyond the railroad.
PIN: stored 44.0067,-97.1678 is in the historic-building core; the camping sections ring it (east blocks within ~200 m) - fine.
